{"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-opus-5-5","id":"msg_vrtx_011ChEmsuRJFUHnRjWdhkhu2","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"text","text":"I fixed four layout bugs in bokehjs that match the problems in the clip. The code compiles, but I haven't seen it work: there's no Chrome here, so I couldn't render the charts. No existing test covers this code, so no test was run either.\n\n1. **Labels and legends getting clipped when they grow** (`src/lib/core/layout/side_panel.ts`). The check that decides whether a chart needs to be laid out again had its comparison backwards. It only fired when an axis, legend or toolbar got smaller. So when tick labels widened (the `…e+9` labels) or a legend label got longer (\"a much longer key lab…\"), the chart kept its old margins and cut them off. It now fires when they grow. It still does nothing when they shrink, which I believe is how Bokeh normally behaves.\n\n2. **Charts spilling out of their row or column** (`src/lib/models/layouts/alignments.ts`). When working out the margins charts should share, each chart's left margin was taken from its last column and its right margin from its first. So a chart spanning several cells, or a chart in a row, picked up a neighbour's margin and didn't fit its slot. Left now comes from the first column and right from the last.\n\n3. **Point area not keeping its given height** (`src/lib/core/layout/border.ts`). The shared top margin was used to size the chart but left out when working out where the point area goes; the other three sides were fine. On charts with a fixed point-area height, that area came out the wrong size or in the wrong place, and the frames in a row didn't line up. The top margin is now handled like the other three.\n\n4. **Rows, columns and tabs never sharing margins** (`src/lib/models/layouts/layout_dom.ts`, `css_grid_box.ts`). Margins were only shared for grid layouts. Rows, columns and linked tabs still lined their point areas up, but without the extra margin that needs. The point areas shrank or slid, and charts side by side or stacked ended up different sizes. Every layout that lines charts up now shares margins first. I moved the call out of `css_grid_box.ts` into the common base class.\n\nTo check it, rebuild with `node make build` and open the same page in a browser. Change tick ranges and legend labels while it's open, since growing labels was what triggered the worst of it."}],"container":null,"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":228,"cache_read_input_tokens":74041,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":228,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0},"output_tokens":8,"speed":"standard"},"input_transformations":[],"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"4aa90695-754e-43a6-8231-d8f514e2b2d9","uuid":"5ec4a4d6-a8c7-45ff-9c93-a285f65b1bf8","timestamp":"2026-11-20T20:00:47.298Z"}
